purpose: Isolate moving-water-table geometry dynamics by prescribing the qualified full-order H(t) trajectory to conservative and literal-published reduced equations on a fine-ish fixed upper discretization.

constitutive.source_convention: positive capillary suction psi=-h in unsaturated branch

geometry_input.source: strict interior zero-pressure crossing H(t) diagnosed in qualified A2 Reference profiles
geometry_input.within_each_observation_interval: linear interpolation between accepted H endpoints

initial_state.source: A2 accepted initial Reference profile at H=120 cm
initial_state.fixed_storages: exact 10-cm Reference cell storages for 0-90 cm
initial_state.moving_storage: total unsaturated storage minus fixed 0-90 cm storage

common_dynamics.fixed_fixed_interface: standard He-2021 adjacent layer-average interface closure
common_dynamics.fixed_moving_interface: same adjacent-layer closure with d_fixed=10 cm and d_moving=H(t)-90 cm
common_dynamics.water_table_conductivity: Ks because moving boundary is the zero-pressure saturated water table

BC2_PUBLISHED_THETA.role: literal displayed-equation diagnostic only; cannot become preferred physics by response fit

numerical_floor.domain: theta_r < theta_bar < theta_s; finite psi and K; moving thickness > 0

reference_comparison.fixed_layer_storage: accepted A2 theta for nodes 1-9 times 10 cm
reference_comparison.q_H_reference: accepted bottom outward exchange divided by 0.0008 day after A2 saturated-zone audit
metrics: max absolute cumulative water-table exchange error
max absolute interval-average water-table flux error

adjudication.conservative_hard_requirement: BC2_CONSERVATIVE physical moving-control-volume ledger must remain <=1e-10 cm and numerical floor must qualify
adjudication.published_role: diagnostic only regardless of response fit because A1 confirmed non-equivalence to moving-control-volume conservation
